failure.title: Search query with markup renders generic error page
failure.rootCause: The search page cannot handle the supplied search text safely. Rather than showing the query as plain text and returning results or an empty-results state, it shows an error screen.
failure.suggestedFix: Investigate search handling for queries containing percent signs and HTML-like markup. Escape the query for display and ensure such input returns a normal results or no-results page rather than the generic error screen.
